title: Measure greatness by what the heart holds
summary: This meets the self still looking for worth in scale or applause. The line says the greatest keep the Lord clasped in the heart.
takeaway: Build greatness inward before seeking it outward.
lifeApplication: Before reaching for a bigger role, deeper title, or faster praise, touch the chest and ask what is actually being held there. Build greatness inward first.

source.shortMeaning: Real greatness is measured by what the heart keeps close.
source.lifeApplication: Before chasing stature, ask what your heart is actually holding close.

evidence.coreClaim: Real greatness is measured by what the heart keeps close.
evidence.turn: Stay humble enough to be kept close and cherished by the Lord.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before reaching for a bigger role, deeper title, or faster praise, touch the chest and ask what is actually being held there. Build greatness inward first.
